noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users can access and interact with the application for assigning tasks.
Task refers to an action item that can be assigned to a user within the web application, which includes a title and description.
Structure refers to the layout and visual arrangement of elements on the page, which is disrupted when a long email is used as an Assignee.

Page refers to the user interface screen that is displayed when assigning a task within the web application, which is expected to maintain its structure despite the presence of long email addresses as assignees.
Email refers to the long identifier associated with an account that is selected as an Assignee when assigning a task on the web interface.
Assignee refers to the account selected to receive a task in the task assignment feature of the web application.
